dedupe_keys.name: mf6pqc v1 0 coupling modflow 6 and phreeqcrm for variable density reactive transport with evolving porosity and hydraulic conductivity

description: Zitao Wang publishes MF6PQC, a Python coupling framework for MODFLOW 6 groundwater flow and transport with PhreeqcRM geochemical calculations. Zenodo archives version 1.0.0 under GPL 3.0, and the linked repository reports the same code licence. The framework retains familiar FloPy and PHREEQC setup patterns and offers sequential or Strang time splitting. Examples allow density, porosity, hydraulic conductivity and diffusion to respond to reactions. It can simulate groundwater and contaminant behaviour around water-supply or industrial infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this coupled release; the catalogue’s MODFLOW agricultural package addresses another problem. A limitation is that coupled results depend on reaction databases, numerical step sizes and solver versions, none of which were checked for a new site. The package was not downloaded, installed or run, and no example mass balance was reproduced.
